name: Silver Ridge Holdings Bhd.
overview: 2026年公司没有公告披露任何业务板块的扩张、缩减、出售或新合约。年内主要事项为公司名称由 Silver Ridge Holdings Bhd 更改为 Tangerine Holdings Bhd，以及多次新股发行和附加上市。财务上，2026财年营收由 39.29 million MYR 增至 55.25 million MYR，净亏损由 1.72 million MYR 扩大至 3.40 million MYR。
overview_en: In 2026, the company did not announce any expansion, reduction, disposal or new contract for its business segments. The main corporate event was the change of company name from Silver Ridge Holdings Bhd to Tangerine Holdings Bhd, alongside multiple new share issuances and additional listings. Financially, FY2026 revenue rose from 39.29 million MYR to 55.25 million MYR, while net loss widened from 1.72 million MYR to 3.40 million MYR.
